title: MORDECAI synthetic oversight console
description: Offline, single-browser simulation of registration, eligibility, exclusive leases, deterministic contention and enforced operator halt. All authority and identity data are invented; no real agents or actuators.

components.label: Operator console
components.description: Roster, intent composer, batch decisions, action history and always-visible halt control.

components.label: Manifest and liveness registry
components.description: Validates synthetic manifests, allowed actions, expiry and heartbeat; reports eligibility without cryptographic claims.

components.label: Synthetic operator policy
components.description: Visible demo-v1 ranks, condition modifiers, promotion values and explicit tie escalation policy.

components.label: Intent and lease arbiter
components.description: Validates announced batches, rejects duplicates, calculates authority, grants exclusive expiring leases and records decision snapshots.

components.label: Simulated executor and halt hooks
components.description: Local state transitions only; revalidates leases and eligibility before simulated execution, cancels pending work and records halt acknowledgements.

components.label: Local session and audit
components.description: Versioned browser-local snapshot with explicit unsaved drafts, durable halt, readable receipts and JSON export; no external service.
